download.headline: Your keys. Your identity. No company in the middle.
download.subtitle: TruthID is an open protocol where your device — not a server — holds the keys. Get the desktop app and the browser extension below.
download.feature1Body: Your private key is generated and stored on your own device. There's no TruthID server that could be hacked, subpoenaed, or shut down.
download.feature2Body: Passwords, documents, and cards, synced end-to-end across your devices. Only your keys can decrypt it — not us.
download.feature3Body: Scan a QR code or approve on your phone. No password to leak, no account to breach.
download.desktopSubtitle: Native app for Linux, Windows, and macOS. Pairs with the mobile app and holds your device key.
download.androidNote: APK — install manually, or via a compatible app store.
download.aptSubtitle: Debian and Ubuntu can install TruthID via APT — updates then come through apt upgrade, like any other package.
download.extensionSubtitle: Autofill and vault access for Chrome and Brave. Not on the Chrome Web Store yet, so it installs manually — takes under a minute.
download.extensionStep1: Download the .zip above and unzip it.
download.extensionStep4: Click “Load unpacked” and select the unzipped folder.
